description:
Finds tickers from a name, part of a ticker or an ISIN, with the exchange of each listing.
        In: one search phrase. Out: up to ten listings, those not yet checked marked as
        such. Typical questions: 'What's the ticker for Vanguard FTSE All-World?'; 'Find
        IE00BK5BQT80.'; 'Is there a euro listing of the Nasdaq 100 ETF?'. Instead: when the
        tickers are already written down, validate_symbols. A bare US-style symbol can name
        a different fund than a European one with the same letters (EQQQ is a US ProShares
        fund; the Invesco UCITS fund is EQQQ.DE / EQQQ.L): give the exchange suffix. It does
        not recommend, predict or calculate tax.
